TODAY
The deck as it stands: Poppins over a violet gradient cover, a plain numbered list inside. Everything below is an alternative to this.

A · EDITORIAL
Ivory ground, a serif display face, hairline rules, violet only as an accent.
Reads as a consultancy document. Calm and credible with government clients.
Trade-off: quiet. Less obviously a technology company.

B · SIGNAL
Dark cover with the brand gradient as a structural spine, geometric sans, tinted cards inside.
Modern and clearly technical.
Trade-off: the dark cover drinks ink in print, and tinted cards can crowd.

C · BLOCKS
Flat colour fields on a strict grid, condensed uppercase display type, oversized numerals.
Confident and memorable at a glance.
Trade-off: the boldest of the three. Some official audiences may read it as loud.
